title: Command Palette的搜索结果的排序可以考虑近期访问的频次

judgment.rationale: Treat this as a ranking-policy enhancement, not a missing-history implementation bug. Current hard relevance tiers deliberately constrain frecency; tuning needs an agreed example/quality fixture rather than a blind weight increase.
evidence: The Chinese feature-form report asks that frequently accessed results rank higher; it supplies no failing query/order pair.
The maintainer confirms frecency exists but may not have enough influence.
